authority: Khalid, 2026-08-05 — the operating rules for the autonomous bus
principle: Each agent verifies the other's work. Neither grades its own (invariant B). Every audit is adversarial-collaborative: find what's wrong AND make it maximally better.

claude.verifies: perplexity's page fixes against live deployed bytes

perplexity.verifies: claude's engine fixes against live feeds/output

1_purpose.name: Understand the intent
1_purpose.question: What is this engine/page actually TRYING to accomplish? What decision does it help the user make? What is the ideal version of this thing?
1_purpose.output: A one-paragraph statement of purpose the auditor writes before critiquing — you cannot audit what you haven't understood.

2_quality.name: Quality of work
2_quality.question: Against an institutional Bloomberg/Koyfin/Google-internal bar, how good is the current implementation? Methodology soundness (backend), visual/UX/a11y grade (frontend), code quality, resilience.
2_quality.output: Ranked strengths (credit given) + ranked weaknesses, each cited to real bytes/output.

3_bugs.name: Find the bugs
3_bugs.question: What is broken, fragile, silently failing, wrong, or misleading? Stale data, unhandled errors, XSS, race conditions, placeholder values, fields computed-but-not-rendered, numbers that don't reconcile.
3_bugs.output: Each bug with severity (P0/P1/P2), exact location, and the fix — grounded in evidence that resolves under invariant A.

4_missing_data_sources.name: What data is missing
4_missing_data_sources.question: THINK DEEPLY: what additional data sources would make this engine/page dramatically better? What does a real institutional desk pull that this doesn't? FRED series, alternative data, cross-asset signals, orthogonal channels, higher-frequency feeds, new APIs. What join across existing fleet feeds is being left on the table?
4_missing_data_sources.output: Concrete named sources (series IDs, APIs, fleet feeds) + why each adds edge + how to wire it.

5_max_improvement.name: Push to the maximum possible
5_max_improvement.question: Ignoring current scope — what is the BEST this could possibly be? What would make it the best-in-the-world version of this dashboard/engine? New visualizations, new computed signals, new interactions, methodological upgrades, ensemble techniques.
5_max_improvement.output: A ranked improvement roadmap, P0 first, each implementable.

workflow.1: Auditor fetches the live target (page bytes or feed JSON) — never audit from memory.
workflow.2: Auditor writes the purpose statement (dimension 1), then works dimensions 2-5.
workflow.3: Auditor files findings as a kind:critique turn on a dedicated frontend-audit-* or engine-audit-* thread, with resolvable evidence (invariant A).
workflow.4: Auditor also posts a machine-readable finding list (JSON) for the other agent's parser.
workflow.5: The OWNER fixes (ships code: propose_patch PR or direct push), posting a kind:propose turn citing the fix.
workflow.6: The AUDITOR verifies each fix against live bytes and posts kind:verify verdict:confirmed — only then does the finding resolve (invariant B: owner cannot self-confirm).
workflow.7: Continuous: the audit loop (2h) and backend heartbeat (15min) keep the queue flowing; new targets get audited on rotation forever.

standards.evidence_or_refusal: Every propose/critique/verify turn carries resolvable evidence or is rejected.
standards.verifier_quorum: Resolution requires a confirmed verify from a non-proposer.
standards.credit_where_due: Audits name strengths, not just faults — the goal is improvement, not dunking.
standards.no_fabrication: Never render or claim a value that isn't real; missing data shows an honest placeholder.
standards.think_deeply: Dimensions 4 and 5 are the point — surface-level bug-listing is insufficient; every audit must propose how to push the target to its maximum.
